format: marble race down a tall peg/ramp/bumper course, camera follows leader, live order strip, photo finish, podium
theme: 8 country flags marble race (country matchups: this account's strongest-reaching theme family; not used by s1 fire vs ice or s2 shark vs octopus today)
viral_reason: VARIETY_RULES rule 2 own results: Windsor last_30dT for eas.ydata, scored (views + 20*likes + 50*comments)/hours since posting; excluding today's s1 snake_duel and s2 brick_siege, flag_drop Race #1 ranks first among lab styles (~7.4/h vs maze_rush ~6.8 and sumo_island ~5.8; stack_race never reached Instagram), and country-themed posts are the account's top reach. Encore of the best-performing eligible style.
music_style: marimba/pizzicato: 124 bpm C major marimba arpeggios over C-Am-F-G with sub bass and a light rim/hat kit locked to the gate pulse, thickening as the race goes on; kalimba peg plinks in C pentatonic, bell bumpers, riser into the photo finish, kalimba + bell fanfare and a soft pad on the podium (module unchanged; mood bed added by the s3 runner)
caption:
Flag Drop · Race #2

Eight flags wait behind the gate. Three seconds, then gravity takes over.

Brazil, Italy, Canada, India, USA, Sweden, Egypt and the UK bounce through pegs, ramps and bumpers while the lead keeps flipping, and the bottom of the course comes down to a photo finish.

Which flag were you riding with when the gate dropped?

#flagdrop #marblerace #countryflags #photofinish #marblerun
